children: Ondo Finance joins the DTCC Tokenization Service ecosystem as a collaborator as the service launches. The service supports institutional asset transfers between traditional and tokenized markets, including transfers for collateral use.

The collaboration strengthens Ondo's role in institutional tokenization through its participation in a service that connects these markets. Ondo is one of several ecosystem collaborators, and the announcement brings no direct change to ONDO's token economics.
We’re excited to be a part of the broader ecosystem of the DTCC Tokenization Service, which launched today.
Ondo Finance joins ecosystem collaborators that include Broadridge, DRW, Fireblocks, and more, advancing connectivity between traditional and tokenized markets.

title: Ondo: Ondo Finance joins DTCC Tokenization Service ecosystem - 28 Oct 2026
